base_observed: P4 Capture + continuous Page Change Loop were reconciled with the served single-host Universal Control and then extended into Anywhere Notes v3: durable page notes, recoverable private audio transcription, files, disposable Pensar sessions, AI-derived continuity and automatic Trabajar selection.
useful_delta: PR #19 merged into main as efeb011e95203fd7ed309a6eb447d2260bc1a4ba after both the dedicated Anywhere Notes gate and the full P4 Continuous Improvement regression gate passed.
The production shell promotion commit 5eb8f6187823fa7a9bd2433ffa337c260265821f moved the manifested V5 product to P4 Anywhere Notes v3 without adding a second global shell.

Phone/desktop audio is saved local-first, uploaded privately and represented with explicit queued/transcribing/retry/error states; linked Prometeo devices can claim abandoned transcription work through a lease instead of leaving audio indefinitely pending.
The active recording state expands into pause/resume/save/discard controls while the closed global control stays compact.
Trabajar automatically selects every current unworked Capture revision and pending attachment on the page; no separate activation/select-notes screen is required.
Pensar creates a private disposable interactive AI session with page memory, notes, files, execution history and prior saved AI-session continuity.

Guardar metabolizes useful thinking into one AI_DERIVED Capture revision plus continuity summary, decisions, negative knowledge, open questions, sources and artifacts; future chats do not require the original ChatGPT transcript.

The Guardar fallback keeps capability token and payload in the URL fragment, removes the fragment from browser history before parsing, and POSTs to the private Edge Function with no-store/referrer protection.
The Work-after-recording race was removed: if an audio save/upload is still in flight, Trabajar/Pensar waits for that save instead of silently dropping the action.
Supabase migration p4_anywhere_notes_ai_sessions_v1 is applied and the repository contains its reproducible schema/RPC migration.
prometeo-change-loop-v1 production Edge Function is ACTIVE at version 4 and its deployed source is mirrored in main.
A synthetic private database test successfully saved an AI session into an AI_DERIVED Capture revision and linked revision record without exposing private payloads publicly.
gh-pages contains the privacy-safe save-session page and the promoted V5 manifested root/chunks.
Publish Prometeo Universal Shell V5 run 34544196762 completed SUCCESS, including the explicit 'Verify GitHub Pages live bytes' step.
decisions: Keep shared/capture/v1 as the single Capture owner and Universal Control V5 as the single global host.
Page-scoped Notes are the durable memory unit; individual recordings are inputs to that stream, not standalone pending jobs the user must manage.
Use two primary semantic actions: Pensar for interactive exploration and Trabajar for implementation/execution.
A Pensar chat is disposable. Durable continuity is the saved AI_DERIVED note/summary, not the private ChatGPT transcript.
A Trabajar worker is disposable after it persists its RETURN/result; the result belongs to page history.
The human's Work/Think click is the action boundary; do not add artificial activation/setup steps.
Private audio/transcripts/session packets/capabilities stay out of GitHub and public coordination.
Software Served is recorded here; Human Accepted remains a separate future fact based on actual use/feedback.
shared_discoveries: A useful mobile recorder should expand while active; minimizing the active state creates unnecessary interaction cost.
Recoverable transcription needs a durable queue/lease model because browser-local Whisper may be interrupted by phone suspension, navigation, reload or device limits.
Continuity improves when AI research is saved as structured derived guidance and later consumed alongside human notes rather than trying to make old chats permanent authorities.
Automatic 'all unworked since last successful result' selection is simpler and safer than asking the user to manually identify the last processed note.
Product publication must verify actual GitHub Pages bytes, not just merge/build state; the final publisher now passed that live canary.
global_delta_candidates: P4 Anywhere Notes v3 is integrated and served: page-local durable text/audio/files/AI guidance, private recoverable audio transcription, Pensar/Guardar continuity, Trabajar automatic unworked selection, and result history all operate through the single Universal Control host.
Human Acceptance was not fabricated by the release; future feedback can create a separate acceptance or refinement delta.
negative_knowledge: Do not restore retired V2/V3 competing global injectors or create a page-local recorder authority.
Do not collapse all audio states into generic 'pending'.
Do not require the user to activate a page/project, manually select notes or recover old chats before Trabajar/Pensar.
Do not put session save tokens or private note payloads in query strings or public coordination.
Do not silently drop Work/Pensar because an audio save is still running; wait for the save or show the active state.
Do not treat AI_DERIVED notes as Human Accepted truth.
Do not claim an old ChatGPT transcript is required for continuity.
Do not infer Human Accepted from green CI or Served bytes.
unresolved: No software blocker remains for the requested Anywhere Notes flow.
Human Acceptance remains unset until actual use/feedback establishes it.
Future device-specific transcription/UX defects should be handled as new observed deltas rather than reopening the completed software frontier by default.
human_boundary: The requested software has been integrated and served. No further human action is required to finish this implementation. Human Acceptance is deliberately separate and may be recorded later from actual use rather than fabricated during deployment.
